gate: RTK C9 HMT lambda=1 S3 reduced scalar Faddeev-Senjanovic block after ell=1 gauge quotient
scope: On the previously frozen round-S3 lambda=1 scalar/conformal second-class block, explicitly remove the four ell=1 spatial-diffeomorphism gauge modes and classify the remaining scalar C12 spectrum and corresponding 2x2 Faddeev-Senjanovic block rank. This is not a full HMT determinant calculation.

frozen_inputs.ell1_classification: the four ell=1 conformal zero modes are spatial-diffeomorphism gauge directions in this frozen block

required_checks: Derive exactly mu_l a^4 = 4[l(l+2)-3] = 4(l-1)(l+3) for the scalar C12 eigenvalue.
Verify mu_1=0 with degeneracy four and remove exactly this ell=1 scalar/conformal gauge subspace from the reduced domain.
Prove mu_l is nonzero for every integer ell>=0 with ell!=1; do not infer positivity because ell=0 is negative.
Record mu_0 a^4=-12 and mu_l>0 for every ell>=2.
For the antisymmetric 2x2 second-class mode block [[0,mu_l],[-mu_l,0]], verify det=mu_l^2>0 on the reduced domain.
Do not report a finite functional determinant: the infinite product over harmonics requires an explicit regularization and normalization prescription not frozen in this gate.
Do not claim the complete HMT gauge-fixed constraint matrix, complete zero-mode quotient, full Faddeev-Senjanovic determinant, full one-loop evaluability, or C9 closure.
Do not import ordinary projectable-Horava beta functions, choose unresolved HMT matter-interface coefficients, change frozen thresholds, allow soft-s retest, or unblock k=0.03 production.
pass_condition: Exact spectral factorization proves that after quotienting the already-classified four ell=1 spatial-diffeomorphism gauge modes, the frozen scalar/conformal C12 block has no remaining zero eigenvalues and every reduced 2x2 FS mode block is nondegenerate, while all full-theory determinant and C9 claims remain open.
fail_condition: Any reduced scalar harmonic has mu_l=0, the ell=1 quotient does not match the prior four-dimensional gauge classification, the 2x2 block determinant is not mu_l^2, or the implementation weakens any frozen semantic restriction.
